owned_invariants: Only a host check certifies. The verdicts are HOST_CERTIFIED, TYPED_REFUSAL and REFUSED, and a proposer, a detector or an adapter carries authority_effect None.
Every ask is reserved and settled against one WholeRunBudget before its reply is read, and a prompt that contains a sealed literal is refused before it is dispatched.

A HostedFamily checks nothing. It asks the host (pfp_operad family next) what to ask, sends each prompt, carries each reply back and takes the verdict and every predicate from the host (family judge). A sealed leak or a malformed task the host reports is raised as the same error a family raises.

When the detail of a hosted verdict carries ledger_failures, which the host returns only for a task that names a ledger_path, those entries are appended to that ledger file, named by the family, the run and the entry, and are left out of the verdict the caller sees.
boundaries: A hosted family without the host binary gives no verdict; it raises the host's error.
The ledger write is the one side effect of a hosted family, and only for a task that names a ledger.
Families not yet moved to the host still check in Python through this module.

score.level_basis: The shared runtime of the workflow families: the loop that asks a model, keeps the budget and the transcript, and, for a hosted family, carries the verdict the Rust host gives. L4 production integration scope; this level asserts integration craft, not algorithmic novelty.

basis.G1: The module docstring states the role and the verdicts; the contract binds AuthorityEffect None and names every exported symbol. Not B: no requirement-to-symbol trace beyond docs/plans/operads_redesign.md.
basis.G2: Budgets are settled in integer microdollars by WholeRunBudget and rationals are read with Fraction and refuse floats; a verdict of a hosted family is the host's. Not B: tested on examples, not proven.
basis.G3: A malformed candidate is a typed MalformedCandidateError, a sealed leak is its own error, and the host's refusals are carried as they are. Not B: no closed table of error codes for this module.
basis.G4: D: executed regression and negative controls are source-bound. No implementation-mutation campaign was run on these bytes, so no mutation ratio is claimed. This is an explicit verification deficit, not an unassessed pass. The 870-test run covers every family through this runtime, and a test runs a hosted family against a ledger file and reads back the entries.
basis.G5: Measured worst cyclomatic 11, cognitive 21, nesting 2; ceiling C, recorded C.
